message.content:
Sure! Use the `maxsplit` argument of `split()` to limit the split to just the first `=`:

```python
temp = "hello=good="
parts = temp.split("=", 1)   # split at most once
print(parts)                # ['hello', 'good=']
```

This will give you exactly `['hello', 'good=']`.
